news.title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
news.summary: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding and spot trading remains well below its October 2025 peak.

news.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
news.summary: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

news.title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
news.summary: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.

news.title: Bitcoin's volatility has plunged, but extreme price swings are more frequent than in 2018
news.summary: CoinDesk analysis finds 10 unusually large trading days in 2026, raising questions about how investors measure risk in an increasingly institutional crypto market.

news.title: Robinhood Chain slowdown spreads from fees to trading as transactions fall more than 40%
news.summary: Daily activity has dropped from 10.8 million transactions to 6.2 million since mid-September even as Robinhood keeps paying network fees on customer swaps.

news.title: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions of dollars in XRP from nothing
news.summary: Researchers demonstrated how a payment could create spendable XRP without the sender funding it, prompting an emergency software release.

news.title: Visa survey says nearly half of APAC consumers open to using stablecoins by 2031
news.summary: Visa’s survey of 14,250 people found interest in stablecoin payments is growing, though only 6% of respondents correctly understood how they work.

news.title: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages
news.summary: The derivatives regulator is proposing a formal rule to include certain contracts traded on platforms like Kalshi's as swaps that require the agency's oversight.

news.title: Winter is coming and energy bills are climbing. ‘Everything just keeps going up.’
news.summary: Expensive utility bills have become an increasingly sharp thorn for Americans’ wallets, but warmer weather this winter and energy assistance programs can help.

news.title: Why Nvidia’s stock is dodging the AI credit scare that is crushing Broadcom and Oracle
news.summary: The P/E ratios have contracted and the CDS spreads have widened in all three cases, but Nvidia appears unscathed

news.title: ‘What you don’t know is greater than anything you do know’: How Ray Dalio would build a portfolio to withstand a popping AI bubble
news.summary: Look for inflation protection and unappreciated players in artificial intelligence, says the famed hedge-fund founder.

news.title: S&P 500 at 10,000 or bust: New ETF offers investors all-or-nothing bet on the index
news.summary: Wall Street has continued to blur the lines between investing and gambling with one recently launched exchange-traded fund.

news.title: ‘I have no children’: My aunt gave me $50,000 for a down payment. Now she wants me to leave my home to her two children.
news.summary: “The house cost $385,000. With my savings, her $50,000 and a small mortgage, I was able to close.”

news.summary: “I presume these are sophisticated investors taking a profit.”
